description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A freestanding bamboo arch carries six plain hooks above a small woven drip tray. Side: The upright frame leans slightly over its widened base. Rear: A rear diagonal brace ties the arch to the back of the base. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
